<h5 class="HeroHome-pillar--heading">Who We Are</h5>
<p></p><p>Kroll, a division of Duff &amp; Phelps, is the leading global provider of risk solutions. We've been helping clients make confident risk management decisions for more than 45 years.</p><p></p>
